answer: Pay agents only for work that outside buyers actually funded and accepted. Each reward traces back to a distinct paying client, and payouts per client are capped, so a sybil swarm can't mint value by trading tasks among itself; a thousand clones serving one buyer split one capped fee. Like a lotus rooted in real mud, income must grow from external demand, not an ivory tower of self-dealing, and when a gale of fake identities arrives, it earns nothing new.
